strings.деревня Колюбаево на Верексе, Рожаловски: the village of Kolyubayevo on the Vereksa, Rozhalovsky stan of Uglich uyezd
strings.деревня Колюбаево на реке Верексе, Рожал: village of Kolyubayevo on the river Vereksa, Rozhalovsky stan of Uglich uyezd
strings.бобыль деревни Колюбаево: bobyl (landless peasant) of the village of Kolyubayevo
strings.В писцовой книге Угличского уезда 1629/1: In the scribal book of Uglich uyezd of 1629/1630 he is recorded in the village of Kolyubayevo on the river Vereksa: «во дв. б. Тимошка Анфилов» ["in the household, bobyl Timoshka Anfilov"]. The letter «б.» stands for a bobyl household, not a boyar.
strings.Тимошка — уменьшительная документальная: Timoshka is a diminutive documentary form of the name Timofei. Anfilov is a designation from the rare name Anfil; without the word "syn" (son) it may be either patronymic or an already fixed family name. This is a new bearer of the stem Anfil- in Uglich uyezd, but he lived almost ninety years after the first record of Onfilogovo in Tver and is not its founder.
strings.На печатной с. 412 читается: «Дер. Колюб: On printed p. 412 one reads: «Дер. Колюбаево, на рчк. на Верекче, а в ней: во дв. б. Тимошка Анфилов» ["Village of Kolyubayevo, on the rivulet Verekcha, and in it: in the household, bobyl Timoshka Anfilov"]. The line has been checked against the page image, not only against automatic text recognition.
strings.Тимошка — обычная уменьшительная форма Т: Timoshka is the usual diminutive form of Timofei in a scribal entry. It is Timofei who is the named person; Anfilov is his second designation.
strings.Форма на -ов естественно читается как св: The form in -ov naturally reads as a link to a man named Anfil — «Анфилов [сын]» ["Anfil's [son]"]. However, in the 17th century such a designation could already be becoming fixed to a family, so it is premature to create an unconditional profile of a father Anfil on the basis of a single line.
strings.Сокращение «во дв. б.» в однотипном пере: The abbreviation «во дв. б.» in a list of uniform entries means a bobyl household. Timoshka was a bobyl head of household who was personally present or registered, not the owner of a votchina (patrimonial estate).
strings.Деревня Колюбаево входила в старую вотчи: The village of Kolyubayevo was part of the old votchina of Ivan Yuryevich Neledinsky. It stood on the river Vereksa in the Rozhalovsky stan of Uglich uyezd; the exact present-day site of the vanished village has not yet been located.
strings.Она документирует ещё одного человека с: It documents one more person with the stem Anfil- within Uglich uyezd and shows the long persistence of the rare name after Tonkoi Onfilogov of 1536/1537.
strings.Почему это не основатель: Why this is not the founder
strings.Между 1539/1540 и 1629/1630 годами почти: Almost ninety years separate 1539/1540 and 1629/1630. The Tver name had long existed already, and Kolyubayevo lay in a different uyezd and a different landholding complex. Timoshka is an important name parallel, but chronologically not the eponym.
strings.Нужны более ранние дворовые списки Колюб: Earlier household lists of Kolyubayevo and neighbouring estates are needed to understand whether Anfilov was a direct patronymic, to find the elder Anfil and to check a possible connection with Tonkoi Onfilogov of Uglich.
strings.Писцовая книга 1629/1630 года прямо назы: The scribal book of 1629/1630 explicitly names the bobyl Timoshka Anfilov in the Uglich village of Kolyubayevo.
strings.КТО НАЗВАН. В 1629/1630 году в деревне К:
WHO IS NAMED. In 1629/1630 in the village of Kolyubayevo on the river Vereksa the scribes recorded the bobyl household of Timoshka Anfilov. Timoshka is an everyday form of the name Timofei; Anfilov is a second designation from the rare name Anfil.

WHERE AND IN WHOSE POSSESSION. Kolyubayevo was part of the old votchina of Ivan Yuryevich Neledinsky in the Rozhalovsky stan of Uglich uyezd. The scribes referred to earlier books of Prince Dmitry Belsky of 1596/1597, but Timoshka is named in the current 17th-century survey.

WHAT «ВО ДВ. Б.» MEANS. This is an abbreviation of the formula «во дворе бобыль» ["in the household, a bobyl"] or «бобыльский двор» ["bobyl household"]. It records the lowest taxpaying status of the household and does not mean a boyar.

SIGNIFICANCE FOR THE NAME. The find expands the Uglich cluster of the name: alongside the 16th-century Tonkoi Onfilogov there is now a direct 17th-century Anfilov. But Timoshka lived too late to have founded the Tver village, already recorded in 1539/1540; moreover, the Rozhalovsky stan lies on the Sit and the Vereksa, not near Nikolskoye Svechino in Tver uyezd.
strings.Найти точную локализацию исчезнувшей дер: Find the exact location of the vanished village of Kolyubayevo on the Vereksa.
strings.Установить, является ли Анфилов прямым п: Establish whether Anfilov is a direct patronymic or already a family name.
